claims.claim: En puede retomar un complemento introducido por de; con referentes personales las formas tónicas son una alternativa normativa y pedagógicamente importante.

entries.notes: R44 audit: en is correctly presented as replacing a de-complement for things/ideas; preverbal and infinitive placement examples are sound. The note about tonic forms for persons is appropriately qualified rather than categorical.
